dialect.detail: Uses JSON GENERATE verb with NATIONAL (PIC N) data and FUNCTION DISPLAY-OF with CCSID 1140, strongly suggesting IBM Enterprise COBOL for z/OS

purpose.domain_detail: Reads a flat file containing records of multiple types (AA, HI) and converts them to JSON output using the JSON GENERATE verb
purpose.summary: This batch program reads an input file containing typed records (AA and HI record types), generates JSON text from each record using the COBOL JSON GENERATE statement, and writes the resulting JSON to an output file. It is a data transformation utility converting flat COBOL records to JSON format.

notable_features: JSON GENERATE verb (COBOL-2014 / IBM Enterprise COBOL 6.x)
PIC N NATIONAL data item for Unicode JSON text
FUNCTION DISPLAY-OF with CCSID 1140 for EBCDIC conversion
EVALUATE on RECORD-TYPE for multi-record-type processing
COPY AALFATS copybook for input record layout
88-level condition names for file status and EOF control
verdict.notes: The use of FUNCTION DISPLAY-OF with codepage 1140 and PIC N NATIONAL strongly indicates IBM Enterprise COBOL for z/OS 6.x. The COPY AALFATS copybook is not shown but presumably defines AA-REC-TYPE, HI-REC-TYPE, and RECORD-TYPE fields. The program appears to be a real utility for converting FATS (possibly a financial or insurance record format) data to JSON.
